An Act to deal with consequential matters arising from the enactment of the Medical Research Future Fund Act 2015, and for related purposes

content.p: This Act may be cited as the Medical Research Future Fund (Consequential Amendments) Act 2015.

Each provision of this Act specified in column 1 of the table commences, or is taken to have commenced, in accordance with column 2 of the table. Any other statement in column 2 has effect according to its terms.

tr.td: 1. Sections 1 to 3 and anything in this Act not elsewhere covered by this table
The day this Act receives the Royal Assent.

The later of the following days: (a) the day after this Act receives the Royal Assent; (b) the day after the Medical Research Future Fund Act 2015 receives the Royal Assent. However, the provisions do not commence at all if the event mentioned in paragraph (b) does not occur.

A single day to be fixed by Proclamation. However, if the provisions do not commence within the period of 6 months beginning on the day Schedule 1 to this Act commences, they commence on the day after the end of that period.

The later of: (a) immediately after the commencement of Schedule 1 to this Act; and (b) the commencement of Schedule 1 to the Acts and Instruments (Framework Reform) Act 2015. However, the provisions do not commence at all if the event mentioned in paragraph (b) does not occur.

content.p: Note: This table relates only to the provisions of this Act as originally enacted. It will not be amended to deal with any later amendments of this Act.
Any information in column 3 of the table is not part of this Act. Information may be inserted in this column, or information in it may be edited, in any published version of this Act.

Legislation that is specified in a Schedule to this Act is amended or repealed as set out in the applicable items in the Schedule concerned, and any other item in a Schedule to this Act has effect according to its terms.

section.heading: Payments relating to the former Health and Hospitals Fund

content.p: The Minister may, by writing, direct that, on a specified day, a specified amount is to be paid to a person if:
the payment relates to the creation or development of health infrastructure; and
(b) before the repeal of Chapter 4 of the Nation-building Funds Act 2008:

the HHF Advisory Board (within the meaning of Chapter 4) had advised the Minister that the making of the payment in relation to the creation or development of that infrastructure satisfied the HHF evaluation criteria; and
the Minister had recommended, under section 258 of that Act, the making of the payment in relation to that infrastructure; and
the person is not a State or Territory.
Note: Chapter 4 of the Nation-building Funds Act 2008 established the Health and Hospitals Fund which provided payments in relation to the creation or development of health infrastructure.
Two or more directions under subsection (1) may be set out in the same document.
A direction under subsection (1) is not a legislative instrument.
The terms and conditions on which a payment is made to a person under section 46AA are to be set out in a written agreement between the Commonwealth and the person.
The person must comply with the terms and conditions.
The agreement may be entered into by the Minister on behalf of the Commonwealth.
The amounts payable under section 46AA are to be paid out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund, which is appropriated accordingly.
This Part has effect as provided by this section.
Grants under section 96 or 122 of the Constitution
This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making grants of financial assistance to a State or Territory.
Medical and dental services

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to payments relating to the creation or development of health infrastructure with respect to the provision of medical and dental services.
Pharmaceutical, sickness and hospital benefits

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to payments relating to the creation or development of health infrastructure with respect to the provision of pharmaceutical, sickness and hospital benefits.
Benefits to students

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments for the purposes of the creation or development of health infrastructure through the provision of benefits to students.
Communication

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments for the purposes of the creation or development of health infrastructure with respect to postal, telegraphic, telephonic or other like services.
Territories

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments for the purposes of the creation or development of health infrastructure in or with respect to a Territory.
Trade and commerce

This Act has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments for the purposes of the creation or development of health infrastructure with respect to trade or commerce:
between Australia and other countries; or
among the States; or
between Territories or between a Territory and a State.
Corporations

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments to a corporation to which paragraph 51(xx) of the Constitution applies for the purposes of carrying out the corporation’s activities.
Race

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments for the purposes of the creation or development of health infrastructure with respect to the people of any race for whom it is deemed necessary to make special laws.
Quarantine

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments for the purposes of the creation or development of health infrastructure with respect to quarantine.
External affairs
This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments with respect to:
Australia’s rights and obligations under an agreement with one or more countries; or
matters that are of international concern.
Patents of invention

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments relating to the creation or development of health infrastructure with respect to the development of patents of invention.
Incidental to powers of the Parliament

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments for purposes relating to matters incidental to the exercise of any of the legislative powers of the Parliament.
Executive power

This Part has the effect it would have if its operation with respect to making payments were expressly confined to making payments for purposes relating to matters incidental to the exercise of any power vested in the Executive Government.
